pages.title: Fashion Closet Sort
pages.creator: Fantasy Realm
pages.description: Fashion Closet Sort asks you to organize a boutique's clothing into matching groups of four. Move the garment at the right end of one closet into an empty space or beside the same type. Finish before time expires, using hints or an extra closet when needed.

pages.title: Pogo Masters
pages.creator: GamesMrkt
pages.description: Pogo Masters turns pogo-stick bouncing into physics-based platform races. Keep your balance while competing against online rivals or a friend on the same computer. Unlock characters, pogo sticks, and trail effects as you work toward a higher leaderboard position.

pages.title: 67 Clicker
pages.creator: Miomi Game Studio
pages.description: 67 Clicker is an idle number-building game centered on clicking the number 67. Tap the number to increase your total, then spend the proceeds on upgrades. Automatic clicking options keep the counter growing as you develop the setup.

pages.title: Jumper's Quest
pages.creator: Yes2Games
pages.description: Jumper's Quest combines platform jumping with short puzzles and enemy encounters. Tap or swipe to launch a jump, aiming for a safe landing and useful pickups. Read each arrangement of obstacles before committing to the next leap.

pages.title: Fish Master: Go Fish
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Fish Master: Go Fish takes you out to sea to build a collection of fish. Throw a spear at swimming targets and bring the catch aboard your boat. Check the fish library to see which species you have found and which remain.

pages.title: Skip Love
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Skip Love follows a stickman through comic puzzles involving romance and dangerous situations. Study the scene and work out how to help him past the current problem. Solutions can involve disguises, distractions, or creating enough chaos to change what happens.

pages.title: Cornhole League - Board Games
pages.creator: TapNation
pages.description: Cornhole League - Board Games challenges you to aim and toss bags in competitive matches. Hold, drag, and release to set up each throw and build your score. Enter tournaments and customize the boards or bags as you explore different venues.

pages.title: Zombie Eeaster Bunnies
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Zombie Eeaster Bunnies sends you into an abandoned village to collect colored eggs. Fight the zombie rabbits with a laser gun or escape their approach, gathering ammunition along the way. Leave the village alive with as many eggs as you can carry.

pages.title: Knife Master : Ball Racing
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Knife Master: Ball Racing asks you to throw knives upward without stabbing a bouncing ball. The ball gains height by landing on the knife handles. Place more knives beneath it and keep the ascent going until you reach the top.

pages.title: Unscrew Wood Puzzle
pages.creator: Supercode Games
pages.description: Unscrew Wood Puzzle asks you to remove bolts in a sequence that frees the blocked pieces. Inspect the wooden and metal arrangement before choosing a screw. Each removal changes what can move, so plan the order rather than opening every fastener immediately.

pages.title: Stickman Halloween Survive
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stickman Halloween Survive puts a white stickman up against monsters positioned on moving platforms. Aim the weapon and choose the right moment to shoot. Watch how the targets move so the shot connects when they pass through your line of fire.

pages.title: GTA Car Rush
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: GTA Car Rush is a driving chase with money to collect around each level. Steer through the route and gather all the cash to open further challenges. Fire rockets when you need to fight while keeping the car moving.

pages.title: Politon
pages.creator: Pinq Games
pages.description: Politon is a turn-based strategy game played across hexagonal territory. Manage your regions' economy, recruit units, and move them to expand your holdings. Different terrains and enemy forces make the order of your investments and attacks important.

pages.title: Cricket Clash Pong
pages.creator: Shanaya
pages.description: Cricket Clash Pong combines cricket batting with a Pong-style exchange. Move left or right to meet the ball and rotate the bat-shaped paddle when needed. Keep returning the ball while balancing your attempts to hit with defending your own end.

pages.title: Idle Town Billionaire
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Idle Town Billionaire lets you buy town lots and turn them into businesses. Profits accumulate automatically, including while you are away, giving you money for further investment. Hire managers and expand the collection of businesses to increase your income.

pages.title: Words Match
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Words Match combines word finding with level-specific targets. Build words from the displayed letters and watch the objective shown beside the board. Upgrade the letter tiles to improve your scoring options as you work through further spelling challenges.

pages.title: Music Cat! Piano Tiles Game 3D
pages.creator: Eccentric Games Studio
pages.description: Music Cat! Piano Tiles Game 3D follows a cat along a musical path of tiles and special blocks. Guide its movement between landings while the soundtrack mixes pop music with cat sounds. Keep the character on the route to finish the song's course.

pages.title: Zombie Die Idle
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Zombie Die Idle puts you on an island overrun by undead enemies. Fight with a sword, gather materials, and develop a defended camp. Build shooting towers and upgrade the base or weapons as you explore more of the island.

pages.title: Emergency HQ City Rescuer
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Emergency HQ City Rescuer challenges you to help falling people reach a safe landing. Watch the obstacles below and time your rescue actions around them. Keep the landing route clear of danger as you work through the city's rescue situations.

pages.title: Up Hill Racing 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Up Hill Racing 2 challenges you to drive across rough tracks in a selection of vehicles. Control acceleration and balance while climbing hills and passing obstacles. Keep the vehicle stable long enough to reach the finish of the selected course.

pages.title: Rolling Ball
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Rolling Ball sends a ball along tracks interrupted by ramps, swinging hazards, hammers, and trampolines. Roll and balance it toward the finish without leaving the road. Pick up boosters when useful and protect your limited lives through each difficult section.

pages.title: Way Down
pages.creator: Gamebol
pages.description: Way Down is a ball-guiding puzzle on colorful platforms. Work through each arrangement to get the ball along a safe route. Keep it from falling away from the platforms, since a fall ends the attempt and forces another try.

pages.title: Idle Farmer Boss
pages.creator: XiferGames
pages.description: Idle Farmer Boss lets you develop a farm by buying land, tending crops, and selling the harvest. Hire farmers to help with production as the business grows. Reinvest your earnings to expand the fields and keep more products moving to market.

pages.title: SmileyWorld Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: SmileyWorld
pages.description: SmileyWorld Bubble Shooter challenges you to clear colorful smiley bubbles and collect characters or animals. Aim, release a shot, and form a group of at least three matching bubbles to pop it. Use booster smileys when an arrangement becomes difficult.

pages.title: Fireman Frenzy
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Fireman Frenzy follows a firefighter carrying a heavy hydrant from blaze to blaze. Aim the hose to put out fires, using ricochets to reach awkward targets. Hold the aim to steady the firefighter, but avoid a returning blast that could knock him out.

pages.title: Heroes Towers
pages.creator: PERSONA•GAMES
pages.description: Heroes Towers lets you build a defensive tower fitted with crossbows and cannons. Fight other players by defending your own structure or attacking theirs alongside an ally. Complete achievements and improve your ranking as you strengthen the fortifications.

pages.title: BMX Kid
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: BMX Kid puts bicycle stunts on difficult riding paths. Keep the bike under control while attempting wheelies, flips, and grinds. Work through the course's challenges and use the available sections to put together another successful trick.

pages.title: Solitaire Seasons
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Solitaire Seasons asks you to clear cards by choosing a value one above or below the current card. Draw from the stock when you need another option, and use jokers to help. Complete forty levels to open the four seasonal windows.

pages.title: Pro Billiards
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Pro Billiards gives you an eight-ball pool table for solo or shared play. Aim and take shots using mouse or touch controls while following the pool rules. Play against a timer or take turns with someone on the same device.

pages.title: Coloring Book Easter
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Coloring Book Easter provides eighteen Easter-themed pictures to fill with color. Choose among fifteen shades and apply them to the outlined artwork. Try different combinations, then save a picture of the finished page before selecting another image.

pages.title: Bitcoin Man Madness
pages.creator: TastyCherryGames
pages.description: Bitcoin Man Madness is a cryptocurrency-themed action shooter with a selection of weapons. Move through the setting, aim and fire, and use jumps or grenades when the situation calls for them. Switch weapons to change how you approach the fighting.

pages.title: Roller Ball 5
pages.creator: Bin Studio
pages.description: Roller Ball 5 follows a bouncing ball through an obstacle-filled platform adventure. Roll left or right, jump across dangerous sections, and stop when you need to avoid a hazard. Time the movement to keep the ball progressing safely through the route.

pages.title: Dropz'n'Heartz!
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Dropz'n'Heartz! is a Valentine's-themed puzzle about clearing a field of hearts. Click the hearts that have reached the largest size and work through the board. Hit three or more hearts to earn bonuses as you continue clearing the field.

pages.title: Flat Jumper Game
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Flat Jumper Game asks you to match a jumping ball's color to the platform it is about to reach. Choose among the three colored buttons at the bottom to change the ball. Read the approaching platforms and switch before the next landing.

pages.title: Squidly Game
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Squidly Game challenges you to reach the destination before the time limit in a red-light, green-light contest. Move while the doll signals green and stop when it signals red. Moving during the red signal eliminates your character from the attempt.

pages.title: Stickman Shooter 3 Among Monsters
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stickman Shooter 3 Among Monsters makes you defend a fort from approaching monsters. Aim at the attackers and stop them before they reach the base. Improve weapon characteristics such as accuracy, firing speed, and reload performance to handle further assaults.

pages.title: Cut For Cat
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Cut For Cat is a rope-cutting puzzle about delivering candy to a cat. Release the suspended sweet and work around bubbles, chains, and other obstacles. Choose the order of cuts so the candy can reach the waiting animal.

pages.title: Angry Shark Miami
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Angry Shark Miami puts you in control of a hungry shark along the Miami coast. Swim through the area and devour targets to build points. Complete the missions while keeping the shark's destructive run moving through the waters.

pages.title: Funny Pet Haircut
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Funny Pet Haircut lets you give a messy alpaca and cat a salon makeover. Wash and dry each pet, then change the coat's color or pattern. Finish by choosing clothing to go with the animal's new hairstyle.

pages.title: Rope Slash 2
pages.creator: mixgame.net
pages.description: Rope Slash 2 asks you to release a suspended ball so it knocks down every can. Cut the rope at a useful moment and let the ball's movement do the work. Clear all the cans to finish the level.

pages.title: Wheel of Rewards
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Wheel of Rewards combines wheel spins with a letter puzzle. Spin for game cash, guess letters, and spend earnings on vowels to reveal more of the answer. Solve the phrase while managing the risk of bankruptcy and losing lives.

pages.title: Dinosaurs game
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Dinosaurs Game combines dinosaur facts with simple interactive activities. Explore illustrated information about names, sizes, and habits, then try puzzles or color the characters with a magic brush. Sound effects accompany the different prehistoric animals.

pages.title: Blocky Tetriz
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Blocky Tetriz challenges you to arrange falling shapes into complete horizontal rows. Move the pieces sideways, lower them, or rotate them to fit the gaps. Finished rows disappear, leaving space to continue organizing the stack.

pages.title: One More Circle
pages.creator: Games Hub
pages.description: One More Circle is an arcade game about linking your movement between circular anchors. Hold to travel around an anchor and release toward the next one. Judge the departure angle carefully to keep the journey going and extend your distance.

pages.title: Penalty Shoot
pages.creator: Best Kids Games
pages.description: Penalty Shoot puts you against a goalkeeper in a penalty-scoring challenge. Aim and take shots to get the ball into the net before losing three balls. Choose each attempt carefully to increase the score before your chances run out.

pages.title: Highway Car Racer
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description: Highway Car Racer lets you choose a car and race along highway roads. Pick a vehicle, change its color, and drive to earn game cash. Try different cars as you continue developing your driving performance.

pages.title: Blocky Shooting Arena 3D Pixel Combat
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Blocky Shooting Arena 3D Pixel Combat is a shooter with pixel-styled soldiers and zombies. Fight in modes such as survival, gun game, or team battles. Choose multiplayer matches with friends or work through the available solo levels against computer opponents.

pages.title: Bike Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Bike Rush is a cycling race on courses with obstacles and acceleration zones. Slide to guide the bike, avoid hazards, and ride over the speed-boosting areas. Keep the rider moving safely to extend the attempt and improve your score.

pages.title: Ice Princess Pregnant Check Up
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Ice Princess Pregnant Check Up follows a fictional prenatal appointment for the Ice Princess. Take measurements, check the heartbeat, and use the available examination tools to see the baby. Continue the character's at-home care activities after the check-up.

pages.title: Construction Trucks Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Construction Trucks Hidden is a matching-card game with truck pictures. Turn over two tiles to look for a pair, remembering the positions of unmatched cards. Clear all the pairs across four levels while keeping your move count low.

pages.title: Tappy Ball
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Tappy Ball challenges you to keep a ball clear of obstacles. Use the mouse button or space bar to control its movement and react to the hazards ahead. Contact with an obstacle ends the current attempt.

pages.title: Flap Cat
pages.creator: GameOnHai
pages.description: Flap Cat puts a cat into a flapping obstacle course. Click or tap to gain height, then let the character descend when there is space. Keep adjusting the flight path to pass the next hazard and extend the run.

pages.title: Bouncing Balls 2
pages.creator: Almanac Group
pages.description: Bouncing Balls 2 is a brick-breaking game about finding useful shooting angles. Aim a stream of balls at blocks to reduce their durability and destroy them. Clear enough space before the bricks reach the bottom and end the game.

pages.title: Flappy Ghost Adventure
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Flappy Ghost Adventure follows a small ghost through a sky full of obstacles. Tap to control its flapping and keep it on a safe flight path. Continue passing the hazards to push your score beyond the previous run.

pages.title: Zombinators
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Zombinators puts a vehicle on hazardous platform-style roads during a zombie outbreak. Use the driving controls to balance over uneven ground and jump past gaps. Keep the wheels on a safe route until you reach the level's finish.

pages.title: City Taxi Driver Simulator : Car Driving Games
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: City Taxi Driver Simulator: Car Driving Games puts you on busy streets collecting and delivering passengers. Pick up each customer and drive to the requested destination before time runs out. Choose camera views and customize taxi vehicles as you complete the jobs.

pages.title: Mentally Disturbed Grandpa The Asylum
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Mentally Disturbed Grandpa The Asylum follows a reporter who wakes inside an old asylum after being captured. Explore the building and investigate the secret hidden in the basement. Find useful items and weapons while searching for a way to escape.

pages.title: Balloon Trip
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Balloon Trip challenges you to protect a balloon as it rises. Use mouse or touch input to keep its ascent safe from the dangers ahead. Continue guarding it for as long as possible to reach a greater height.

pages.title: In The Path
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: In The Path makes a ball's direction changes the key to survival. Click or tap to turn before it collides with a wall. Collect gems for additional skins and keep following the path to improve your best score.

pages.title: Spiral Stairs
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Spiral Stairs sends a cat up a twisting staircase filled with hazards. Hold to climb and release to stop, timing movement around spikes, rotating blocks, and falling objects. Keep ascending to reach a greater height and unlock more themes.

pages.title: Casino Classic
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Casino Classic combines blackjack, video poker, and slot-machine play in a casino game collection. Choose a mode and use game currency for its rounds, hands, or spins. A lucky wheel provides another activity alongside the three main games.

pages.title: Cap Boy Run
pages.creator: Game-Game.com.ua
pages.description: Cap Boy Run follows a runner trying to reach his girlfriend. Guide him past the obstacles blocking the route and keep the attempt going. Watch the next part of the path so the character can continue toward the reunion.

pages.title: Snowball.io
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Snowball.io is an arena game about building snowballs and knocking opponents out. Move to grow your snow, then push or launch it toward another player. Choose between one large snowball and smaller attacks while keeping yourself on the playing field.

pages.title: Logical Theatre Six Monkeys
pages.creator: Rumata Lab
pages.description: Logical Theatre Six Monkeys turns the familiar frog-swapping puzzle into a monkey stage act. Move the two groups through the available space and exchange their positions. Plan the jumps carefully so a misplaced monkey does not block the remaining moves.

pages.title: Kids Secrets Find the Difference
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Kids Secrets Find the Difference asks you to compare pictures and locate seven changed details. Each of the ten levels gives you one minute to find them all. Study the small objects and shapes carefully before selecting a difference.

pages.title: Newyork City Plumber
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Newyork City Plumber is a pipe puzzle about arranging a connected route through a grid. Turn or exchange pipe pieces to line up their openings and complete the pipeline. Study the bends before moving a section that another connection depends on.

pages.title: Tap The Rat
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Tap The Rat puts you in charge of catching rats and mice before time expires. Tap the targets quickly and collect bonuses when they appear. Keep watching the play area so fewer rodents escape your attention during the countdown.

pages.title: Dracula Quest : Run For Blood
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Dracula Quest: Run For Blood is a platform adventure starring a hungry Dracula. Guide the vampire through the route while pursuing his next meal. React to the platforming challenges ahead to keep the run and the search for blood going.

pages.title: Road of Fury Desert Strike
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Road of Fury Desert Strike follows Rass in a battle against the Horsemen gang and its leader, Duke Mo. Aim at enemies while the action moves through the wasteland. Earn payment for defeats, hire drivers, and improve your equipment.

pages.title: Poker World
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Poker World sends you through poker tournaments across a collection of famous casino cities. Play hands against computer opponents and decide when to bet, bluff, or fold. Work through the tour while testing your decisions at different tables.

pages.title: Agnes Solitaire
pages.creator: Novel Games Limited
pages.description: Agnes Solitaire asks you to move every card onto four suit foundations that begin at the starting card's rank. Build same-colored descending sequences in the tableau, wrapping ranks when needed. Draw another row from the stock when no useful move remains.

pages.title: VIP Princesses Paris Fashion Week
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: VIP Princesses Paris Fashion Week lets you style Cinderella and Aurora as guests at a fashion event. Browse their dresses and combine the available pieces into complete outfits. Give each princess a look for the Paris shows.

pages.title: Pizza Cafe
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Pizza Cafe puts you behind the counter making pizzas for waiting customers. Consult the cookbook, prepare the requested recipe, and serve it before the customer loses patience. Timely service earns tips and helps keep the queue moving.

pages.title: Shopaholic: Rio
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Shopaholic: Rio follows a shopping holiday among Rio's stores and parties. Browse the available fashion choices and put together outfits for the vacation. Move between the shopping and social activities while developing the character's holiday wardrobe.

pages.title: Princess Adolescence Problems
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Princess Adolescence Problems follows Sofia's visit to a salon for a fictional skin and hair makeover. Use the available treatments on her complexion, then work through the hairstyling choices. Complete the salon steps to finish her refreshed appearance.
